page.overview:
Who is Poleine?

Poleine was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around.

Elayna Sedai is raised to Amyrlin Seat while Poleine is away from the White Tower on a foreign mission

She is believed to have been close to uncovering the secret to unlocking a certain Portal Stone. She was later captured by the Black Ajah and rescued by Elayna.
